method: Viewed original 034 and 049 pixels and all 10 current candidate renders; compared Chronal v4 front, Graft pass05 front and pass06 planar diagnostic profile. Read-only source review; no repository edits. SHA256 verification is file identity evidence only.
limits: No new Blender source-open/import test or render performed by this reviewer.
No engine, animation-clearance, character-fit, performance or GPU certification.
Visual findings are qualitative, not automated silhouette scores. Illustrative source views are not mutually exact engineering orthographs.

improvementsVsV4: Broad dark hub replaced by brass bearing cover with smaller dark center, closer to reference material distribution.
Hooked crescents replace shallow triangular blades; clearer curved blade identity.

remainingVisualGaps.finding: Broad flat rectangular bridge and cuff dominate silhouette; reference shows a compact articulated assembly with narrower curved carriers and more visible negative space.
remainingVisualGaps.nextRepair: Trace carrier outline and hub-to-blade proportions from wrist construction panel; reduce slab area and form distinct curved supports.

remainingVisualGaps.finding: Blade roots and continuous wide crescents remain too broad; reference blade carriers, cutouts and pointed transitions differ.
remainingVisualGaps.nextRepair: Match each visible deployed and stowed contour and preserve separate carrier/blade boundaries.

remainingVisualGaps.finding: Brass is bright and uniformly orange; plate edges, cleats and hub read coarse. Reference has darker aged brass, small fasteners, layered bearing recesses and brushed steel.
remainingVisualGaps.nextRepair: Refine manufacturing forms first, then local roughness/wear and material value under a fixed neutral lighting rig.

remainingVisualGaps.finding: Large smooth cuff lacks the glove, wrap and strap construction visible in wrist-fit reference. Neutral fixture demonstrates placement only.
remainingVisualGaps.nextRepair: Validate on actual character glove with stowed/deployed wrist poses and clearance sampling.

gates: Motion clearance and actual glove/character fit
Revised runtime exports and engine checks

improvementsVsPass05: Elongated split husks replace overlapping short bud scales; crown is closer to the source elongated wood pod.
Thinner alternating leaf sprigs and clearer root spread move toward source fine branching.
True profile has branch/root depth beyond the preserved planar diagnostic.

remainingVisualGaps.finding: Crown still reads as a symmetric rib cage around an exposed smooth orange droplet. Source has irregular layered broken wood enclosing a smaller angular opening.
remainingVisualGaps.nextRepair: Vary splinter widths, curvature, overlap and break tips; narrow the central opening and integrate sap into the husk.

remainingVisualGaps.finding: Branches form a clean broad Y; shaft fibers look smooth, continuous and evenly combed. Reference has irregular interlocking forks, knots, recesses and broken ridges.
remainingVisualGaps.nextRepair: Rebuild dominant branch junctions and interrupted twisted wood masses before adding texture noise.

remainingVisualGaps.finding: Uniform reddish brown surface and fine parallel striations lack source golden ridge edges, dark fissures and moss pockets. Leaves remain sparse and simple.
remainingVisualGaps.nextRepair: Add localized bark relief and value variation tied to geometry; author uneven leaf/moss clusters in reference locations.

remainingVisualGaps.finding: Profile crown appears mostly closed and narrower than source side illustration; no held or docked view exists in this candidate.
remainingVisualGaps.nextRepair: Compare three-dimensional crown and branch depth in a matched side view; add actual hand/back contact renders after primary form repair.

gates: Revised runtime exports and engine checks
